changelog:
Initial release of the crypto "search" skill for content discovery and synthesis.

- Enables advanced content search and synthesis from Twitter (X) and News using Kaito MCP tools.
- Supports searching by token, keyword, indexed topic, and Twitter username.
- Detailed search behavior guidance provided: AND logic, exact matching, proximity matching, and syntax for boolean expansion.
- Strong recommendations on query structuring and parameter selection to maximize relevance and recall.
- Clarifies use cases and boundaries (not for mindshare tracking, sentiment, or user profiling).
- Supports special text modifiers and detailed boolean operator rules for precise search.
